description: List the signed-in user's mail messages, optionally filtered by read state, newest first.

is_read.description: Optional read-state filter; when set, only messages with this isRead value are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a Graph-style value list of message resources.

description: Get a single mail message by its id.

message_id.description: The unique id of the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the message resource; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Send a mail message on behalf of the signed-in user.

to_recipients.description: List of recipient email addresses (the first is used as the primary recipient).

subject.description: Optional message subject; defaults to '(no subject)'.

content_type.description: Optional body content type ('HTML' or 'Text'); default HTML.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has status 'accepted' and the new message id; on failure (no recipients), output contains an error message.

description: List the signed-in user's calendar events, ordered by start time.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a Graph-style value list of event resources.

description: List the signed-in user's contacts, ordered by display name.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a Graph-style value list of contact resources.
